purpose: Restrained historical colourisation for the nuclear intelligence events

prompts.enrichment: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: historical Hearts of Iron IV event photograph. Input image: the sole referenced image is the exact edit target, a historical industrial construction photograph. Primary request: faithfully COLORIZE this existing black-and-white photograph, preserving the photograph's entire composition, viewpoint, framing, every visible person, construction structure, and the original irregular pale photographic border and black outer frame. Keep the image rectangular with exactly the same aspect ratio. Add only restrained, realistic period colours: weathered timber, rust-brown and grey steel, muted earth and concrete tones, subdued work clothing, and a pale natural sky. Historical documentary photography, plausible mid-20th-century materials, lightly aged muted colour film, clear but not oversharpened. Preserve original grain, lighting, shadows and all architectural detail. Do not invent objects or reconstruct a different building. Do not crop, zoom, widen, extend, add text, symbols, labels, or a watermark. Colourisation only. Output one opaque colour photograph.
prompts.weapons: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: historical Hearts of Iron IV nuclear intelligence event photograph. Input image: the sole referenced image is the exact edit target, a historical research laboratory photograph. Primary request: faithfully COLORIZE this existing black-and-white photograph, preserving the entire photograph, all people and their exact poses, faces and clothing, every pipe and instrument, viewpoint and lighting, and the original irregular pale photographic border with its black outer frame. Keep exactly the original rectangular aspect ratio. Add only restrained, realistic period colours: warm off-white laboratory coats, natural subdued skin tones, dull grey and dark green industrial equipment, copper/brass details where plausible, and muted blue-grey or khaki clothing. Documentary mid-20th-century colourisation with original grain and gentle, low saturation colour. No modern screens, no extra equipment, no new people, no glowing effects, no text, labels or watermark. Do not crop, zoom, widen, extend or change any structure. Colourisation only. Output one opaque colour photograph.

color_accuracy: Plausible reconstructed colours; not documented historical colours.
packaging: Resize to native dimensions and restore the original alpha mask; no creative edits in packaging.
